cause_quote: The loop added `const update = await prepare(state.context);` after the steering checkpoint, moving permission-prompt refresh on Claude continuations into a window where newly accepted steers missed the next request.
user_saw: A correction accepted while the agent prepared its next request had to wait through another model response before taking effect.
summary: The fix checks for steering after request preparation and applies any accepted input to the upcoming model request when no steering batch has already been committed.
reasoning: I checked the causing commit and its parent: the parent awaited permission-prompt refresh through `prepareNextTurn` before draining steering when no batch was pending. The causing commit moved that refresh into `prepareContinuation` after the drain, so an input accepted during the refresh missed dispatch. A later commit added the same ordering gap for background-result placement, which the failed Code Mode cell test exercises through `beforeRequest`.
